E4Plus1.uk.description: The Help: Jay and Manny aren't happy when Gloria hires a too-good-to-be-true male nanny. Frank's in town and feeling lonely, so Phil and Jay take him out to get his groove back. (S5 Ep6)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's Hotel Hell
E4Plus1.uk.description: Landoll's Mohican Castle: Gordon Ramsay visits a custom-built, multi-million-dollar hotel in Loudonville, Ohio. Can he help the struggling business and its overworked owner? (S3 Ep8)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's 24 Hours to Hell and Back
E4Plus1.uk.description: Lowery's Seafood Restaurant: Gordon revamps Lowery's Seafood in Tappahannock, Virginia, where he finds two brothers - the owner and the manager - at loggerheads. (S3 Ep1)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's 24 Hours to Hell and Back
E4Plus1.uk.description: Blend on Main: Gordon Ramsay and his team visit struggling Blend on Main in New Jersey and give it a spectacular renovation, a new menu and hope for the future. (S3 Ep2)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's 24 Hours to Hell and Back
E4Plus1.uk.description: Caneda's White Rooster: Gordon Ramsay revamps a Cuban-inspired restaurant in Toms River, New Jersey. Owner Patty opened the place to showcase her grandmother's Cuban cooking. (S3 Ep3)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Dangerous Curves: Homer and Marge head to a log cabin for the weekend and reminisce about their early courtship. (S20 Ep5/21)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Homer and Lisa Exchange Cross Words: Lisa discovers that she has a knack for crosswords and enters a tournament. But Homer thinks he can make money by betting on her to lose. (S20 Ep6/21)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Ten-Per-Cent Solution: The TV network cancel Krusty the Clown's show. Can his first agent, Annie (Joan Rivers), help him craft a comeback? (S23 Ep8/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Politically Inept, with Homer Simpson: Homer gets his own political talk show after a video of his impassioned rant about how he was treated at the airport goes viral. (S23 Ep10/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Daughter Also Rises: Lisa meets an intellectual romantic who shares her passion for culture. (S23 Ep13/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: At Long Last Leave: The Simpsons are evicted from Springfield and join an off-grid community, but Marge and Homer meet hostility when they try to sneak back into town. (S23 Ep14/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: How I Wet Your Mother: Homer develops a bedwetting habit, so the family infiltrate his dreams and search for clues in his subconscious to find the source of his problem. (S23 Ep16/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Dog
E4Plus1.uk.description: (2022) Poignant road-trip comedy with Channing Tatum. A soldier with PTSD must escort a traumatised army canine to a comrade's funeral. Can man and dog save each other's lives?

E4Plus1.uk.title: Celebrity Gogglebox
E4Plus1.uk.description: The celebrities watch: This Morning, Dating Around, Mission: Impossible - Rogue Nation, Hostile Planet, Big Brother: Best Shows Ever, EastEnders and The Repair Shop. (S2 Ep4)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Gogglebox
E4Plus1.uk.description: The top TV includes: Strictly Come Dancing, Celebrity SAS: Who Dares Wins, A Very Royal Scandal, The Yorkshire Vet, This Morning (gurning) and My Mum, Your Dad. (S24 Ep3) [SL]

E4Plus1.uk.title: Gogglebox
E4Plus1.uk.description: On the 'Box: Strictly Come Dancing, Phillip Schofield: Cast Away, Nightsleeper, Emily in Paris, First Dates, Made in Bondi, Roux Back Down the River and Only Connect. (S24 Ep4)

E4Plus1.uk.title: First Dates
E4Plus1.uk.description: A retired champion car racer meets a champion ballroom dancer who's looking for a man 'with balls'. And sparks fly when Babestation model Rebecca meets leather-clad Mak. (S23 Ep5) [SL]

E4Plus1.uk.title: Vanderpump Rules
E4Plus1.uk.description: Pump Fiction: A photoshoot goes downhill when Angelica reveals what was found in Jason's shower. And Demy decides to move on from her friendship with Natalie. (S12 Ep6)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Vanderpump Rules
E4Plus1.uk.description: Paso Aggressive: Lisa throws an intimate 20th anniversary party to celebrate the founding of SUR. Angelica spills a secret that threatens to upend the group. (S12 Ep7)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Vanderpump Rules
E4Plus1.uk.description: Speakerphone Suckerpunch: In Paso Robles, an overheard phone call makes Audrey rethink her relationship with Chris. And the group enjoy a wild night out. (S12 Ep8)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Don't Tell the Bride
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Sk8er Boi One: Will Andy's plans for a skater-themed wedding make his bride Bobby's wheels spin? Or will there be broken bones and broken hearts on the big day?

E4Plus1.uk.title: Don't Tell the Bride
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Obstacle Course One: Chris wants his bride to jump through hoops, and plans to turn his wedding into an obstacle course. But Charlotte dreams of a traditional family wedding.

E4Plus1.uk.title: Hollyoaks Omnibus
E4Plus1.uk.description: Beth is desperate to make things better between her and Maddox. There are tears, squabbles and shocks during Hollyoaks High parents' evening. And does Kathleen-Angel see a future with Ant?

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: ClosetCon '13: Jay begrudgingly returns to ClosetCon, and things get interesting when he's reunited with some old colleagues. Cam takes Mitch and Lily to the Tucker family farm. (S5 Ep8)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Don't Tell the Bride
E4Plus1.uk.description: The One with All the Boxing: Former boxing champ Jordan plans a fight-night wedding in front of thousands, while his bride-to-be Danielle dreams of a feminine and intimate day.

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's Hotel Hell
E4Plus1.uk.description: Beachfront Inn & Inlet: Gordon Ramsay visits a 'Caribbean-style' resort hotel in Fort Pierce, Florida, where guests face dusty rooms, late-night concerts and poor service. (S3 Ep7)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's 24 Hours to Hell and Back
E4Plus1.uk.description: Botto's Italian Line Restaurant: Gordon visits a family-owned business, which he thinks looks like a funeral parlour. He and the team give it a renovation along with a new menu. (S3 Ep4)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series - Boodles Restaurant: Octogenarian restaurant owner Bruno is running himself into the ground. Can his son and general manager Kevin step up to the plate? (S10 Ep6)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Them, Robot: Mr Burns replaces the power plant's staff with robots but decides to keep Homer as the only human employee. (S23 Ep17/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: A Totally Fun Thing Bart Will Never Do Again: Bart sees an ad for the ultimate cruise, begs his parents for a holiday, and then tries to make the vacation last forever. (S23 Ep19/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Spy Who Learned Me: While he's on sick leave, Homer learns how to be a better husband, with the help of dashing spy movie crime fighter Stradivarius Cain (Bryan Cranston). (S23 Ep20/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Great British Bake Off
E4Plus1.uk.description: It's Biscuit Week. Whose cookies, nostalgic classics and visually striking mosaics will stir up Nigella and Paul's emotions, and how will the cookie crumble? (S17 Ep2/10) [SL]

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Springfield Splendor: Lisa and Marge team up on a graphic novel that becomes a musical. But Marge takes all the credit... (S29 Ep2/21)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Whistler's Father: Maggie reveals a hidden talent, which Grampa tries to exploit. Marge gets a job as a decorator for the mob. (S29 Ep3/21)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Mypods and Broomsticks: Homer suspects that Bart's new friend's Muslim family are terrorists. Meanwhile, Lisa becomes addicted to downloading songs on her new Mypod. (S20 Ep7/21)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Burns and the Bees: Mr Burns wins a basketball team in a game of poker, then decides to build a stadium on top of Lisa's bee colony. (S20 Ep8/21)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Lisa the Drama Queen: Lisa and her new friend Juliet (Emily Blunt) create a fantasy world that takes them a bit too far from reality. (S20 Ep9/21)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Take My Life, Please: Homer is annoyed when his old high school nemesis Vance Connor gets a spot on the Springfield Walk of Fame. (S20 Ep10/21)

E4Plus1.uk.title: New: Lego Masters Australia
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series - Fresh Food People: From Captain Corn to Banana Boy, a new universe of superheroes assembles, as our 'pears' pit their nutritious victors against rotten villains. (S7 Ep8)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Uncharted
E4Plus1.uk.description: (2022) Going-for-gold action. Tom Holland and Mark Wahlberg compare abs as they scour the globe for an olde explorer's lost gold. The heat is on. The time is right. Only the best survive.

E4Plus1.uk.title: Mission: Impossible - Dead...
E4Plus1.uk.description: ...Reckoning: (2023) Tom Cruise returns as Ethan Hunt and jumps a motorbike off a mountain for real. There's some stuff about an all-powerful AI. But it's the thrills that we're here for!
